normalization.scope: Same evaluated rows and train/test split per feature across input variants; source norms measured before optional main normalization.
normalization.interpretation: Direction-only gains or losses describe this linear pipeline; fit telemetry does not prove general training stability.

topology.sample_scope: Seeded uniform samples of evaluated rows; identical IDs across models and spaces. H1 uses an explicit smaller subset of the first sample.
topology.metric_scope: Exact complete pairwise distances within each sample; no ANN graph or projection is used.
topology.null_scope: Whole observed label/tag rows shuffled within the sample; known mask fixed; strata respected only in stratified mode.
topology.interpretation: Positive null-minus-observed gap suggests annotation organization across scales. It does not establish linear separability or semantic usefulness.
topology.uncertainty: Repeated-sample min/max bands are descriptive, not confidence intervals. No persistence significance test is claimed.
